messages:
Tessa (on-call): morning handoff — quick summary of last 4 hrs. had a customer-impacting blip around 03:12 UTC where p95 generation latency spiked from ~180ms to ~1.8s for embeddings-backed routes. incident-bot: Pager #7542 triggered (embedding-io-surge) at 03:12. alerts: p95-gen > 1s, error-rate up 0.7%, queue depth up on batcher.

Tessa (on-call): what we saw: sudden increase in small embedding-only requests from a single partner region (eu-west). autoscaler for embedding workers started rapidly adding pods which caused KV cache pressure and a KV eviction cascade. that in turn broke cache hits for prefix caching and the runtime fell back to cold KV reads -> higher latency + occasional 503s.

oncall-bot: automated mitigation applied: admission-control throttle for embedding routes (rate limit set to 60r/s), rolled back last platform commit (deploy 2026-03-07-embed-hotfix) to reduce throttle noise.

Ravi: confirmed the spike source — it’s a bulk reindex job from Partner A hitting the hosted API with lots of short sequences. they exceeded their quota spike. asked them to pause; awaiting reply (they acked and paused at 03:25).

Miguel: mitigation we applied: temporarily turned on sticky routing for eu-west embedding pool to reduce cross-zone KV churn, increased KV eviction threshold from 70% -> 85% for embedding cache only, and disabled dynamic preemption for those nodes. also disabled a small experimental batching mode that increased micro-batches for embeddings.

Kevin: metrics look good post-changes — p95 down to ~220ms, error-rate back to baseline. saw one downstream retry backlog at 03:40 but it drained.

Tessa (on-call): customer impact: short-lived higher latency for ~37k requests over ~13 minutes, ~0.4% requests returned 503/429 — all retried successfully after mitigation. partner A impacted most; other customers saw <50ms extra p95. no data loss.

Nora: follow-ups I need to run: 1) collect a request sample + logs for partner A and upload to secure ticket (Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-9876) 2) run kv-cache diagnostic sweep to find hotspots 3) recommend a quota cap for heavy reindex jobs + doc for partners on reindex best-practices.

Tessa (on-call): coverage swap: I need to switch primary duty at 08:00 UTC to Miguel due to timezone. Miguel will be primary (pager), Ravi secondary. Kevin will be float for infra escalations. I'll remain reachable for 1hr after handoff for context.

Miguel: ack — I'll pick up primary at 08:00 UTC. immediate next steps for incoming shift: 
- verify embedding pool health (prom: redwood_embedding_pool_nodes, kv_eviction_pct)
- check admission-control rates: `/api/v1/admin/admission?route=embeddings`
- ensure sticky routing is still enabled for eu-west if traffic remains bursty
- watch for autoscaler oscillation (prom: embedding_autoscaler_scale_events)

Tessa (on-call): runbook pointers: 
- Runbook: Embedding pool overload -> https://internal.redwood/docs/runbooks/embedding-eviction-resolve (see section "sticky-routing + cache-raise")
- Quick cmds: 
```
# temporarily raise eviction threshold for embeddings
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' https://control-plane.internal/kv/cache_policy -d '{"pool":"embeddings","evict_threshold":85}'
# enable sticky routing for eu-west
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/routing/toggle -d '{"pool":"embeddings","region":"eu-west","sticky":true}'
```

Miguel: noted. I'll also create a short sanity check script to run on shift start that hits a pre-warmed embedding keyspace and ensures <300ms p95. will post it to the ops-snippets channel.

Ravi: long-term action items: 1) quota gating for bulk reindex jobs (engineered limit + partner onboarding doc) 2) add smoother autoscaler cooldown for embedding pool (currently 30s, propose 2m with rate limit) 3) KV cache instrumentation for per-tenant churn. I'll file JIRA tasks after handoff.

Tessa (on-call): open items at handoff: 
- Partner A follow-up: ensure they resume after guidance (assigned: Ravi)
- KV diagnostic sweep (assigned: Nora)
- Autoscaler cooldown PR (assigned: Ravi)
- Postmortem? low impact but customer-facing — optional blameless note to partners. decide after 24h if we need a PM sync.

oncall-bot: incident #7542 status: mitigated -> monitoring. pages closed: 1.

Kevin: FYI I also applied a temporary log-sampling rule to avoid S3 billing spike from full request dumps — set sampling to 10% for embedding routes. revert when we confirm normality.

Tessa (on-call): okay team, handoff checklist complete. Miguel primary at 08:00 UTC, Ravi secondary. My last note: if you see autoscaler thrash again, flip admission-control to 40r/s for a minute and notify infra. thanks :thumbsup:

Miguel: thanks — will update if anything else crops up.

Tessa (on-call): signing off from primary in 10m, leaving bridge open for 30m.
